refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoLexerNext` function advances the `SilikoLexer` object to its next token.
* `Lexer` is the lexer to advance. If `Lexer` has reached the end of its input, further calls to `SilikoLexerNext` on `Lexer` will have no effect, and `SilikoLexerGetToken` will return a token indicating the end of input has been reached.
